755bd2ef025d.raw:
FROM logs-endpoint.events.process-*
| WHERE event.category == "process"
  AND event.type == "start"
  AND process.name IN ("ollama", "ollama.exe", "gpt4all", "gpt4all.exe", "LM Studio.exe", "lmstudio")
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.name, process.command_line, process.executable
| SORT @timestamp DESC
755bd2ef025d.desc: A local LLM runtime or model-serving process appears on a host outside the approved AI inventory.

bd4b2c3aa1c3.raw:
rule llminjection_det_ai_002_local_llm_runtime {
  meta:
    author = "LLMInjection"
    description = "Detect local LLM runtime process creation outside approved inventory"
    severity = "MEDIUM"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(?i)(ollama|gpt4all|lm[ _-]?studio)(\\.exe)?$`)

  condition:
    $e
}
bd4b2c3aa1c3.desc: A local LLM runtime or model-serving process appears on a host outside the approved AI inventory.

54b51ba04aeb.desc: A workload with no approved AI dependency contacts an LLM provider or AI gateway.

0c5890a1-52e4-4ca1-884c-4f4047f71ef7.raw:
title: Unauthorized Local LLM Runtime
id: 0c5890a1-52e4-4ca1-884c-4f4047f71ef7
status: experimental
description: Detects common local LLM runtime processes on systems where such software is not expected.
references:
  - https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/LLmInjection
author: LLMInjection
date: 2026-09-30
tags:
  - llminjection.det-ai-002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/ollama'
      - '\\ollama.exe'
      - '/gpt4all'
      - '\\gpt4all.exe'
      - '/lmstudio'
      - '\\LM Studio.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Approved developer, research or AI inference workstations.
level: medium
0c5890a1-52e4-4ca1-884c-4f4047f71ef7.desc: Detects common local LLM runtime processes on systems where such software is not expected.

9d8a30f8-5318-4772-afa5-9a705941dad5.raw:
title: Assistant or IDE Config Written by Non-Editor Process
id: 9d8a30f8-5318-4772-afa5-9a705941dad5
status: experimental
description: >
  Detects creation or modification of AI assistant and IDE configuration or hook files by processes
  that are not approved editors, version-control clients or package managers. Hidden assistant
  configuration inside a repository can instruct a coding agent to run attacker-controlled commands.
references:
  - https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/from-prompting-to-autonomy-the-evolution-of-adversarial-ai
  - https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/LLmInjection
author: LLMInjection
date: 2026-10-07
tags:
  - llminjection.det-ai-011
  - llminjection.llmi-t018
logsource:
  category: file_event
detection:
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/.claude/'
      - '\\.claude\\'
      - '/.cursor/'
      - '\\.cursor\\'
      - '/.vscode/'
      - '\\.vscode\\'
  filter_approved_writers:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/git'
      - '\\git.exe'
      - '/code'
      - '\\Code.exe'
      - '/cursor'
      - '\\Cursor.exe'
      - '/claude'
      - '\\claude.exe'
  condition: selection_path and not filter_approved_writers
falsepositives:
  - Approved bootstrap scripts, dotfile managers and enterprise IDE provisioning tools; allowlist them by path and signer.
  - Language servers and extension hosts that write workspace settings; allowlist after inventory.
level: high
fp: Language servers and extension hosts that write workspace settings; allowlist after inventory.
9d8a30f8-5318-4772-afa5-9a705941dad5.desc:
Detects creation or modification of AI assistant and IDE configuration or hook files by processes
that are not approved editors, version-control clients or package managers. Hidden assistant
configuration inside a repository can instruct a coding agent to run attacker-controlled commands.

2d6e281d-7f91-4908-b1d5-5d0bea637892.raw:
title: Package Installer Command Line
id: 2d6e281d-7f91-4908-b1d5-5d0bea637892
name: llmi_det_ai_029_package_install
status: experimental
description: |
    Building block for the correlation rule that follows: a package-manager install or add
    command. On its own it matches routine developer activity and is not meant to alert.
references:
    - https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/LLmInjection/blob/main/data/detections.json
author: LLMInjection
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
    - llminjection.det-ai-029
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    definition: 'Full command line must be collected.'
detection:
    selection_npm_family:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'npm install'
            - 'npm i '
            - 'pnpm add'
            - 'pnpm install'
            - 'yarn add'
    selection_pip_family:
        CommandLine|contains:
            - 'pip install'
            - 'pip3 install'
    condition: 1 of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - 'Every developer or CI package installation; the rule is only a building block for the correlation.'
level: informational

---
title: Potential AI Assistant Config Write Following Package Installation
id: 61996696-62c9-4e3f-b5e5-13ebff33f134
status: experimental
description: |
    Detects a coding-assistant configuration write on the same host within ten minutes of a
    package-manager install command. A dependency that plants hooks or instructions for
    coding agents (see the repository's AI supply-chain incidents) looks like this. The
    correlation is per host, not per process, because the writer is usually a child of the
    install process and carries a different process identifier.
references:
    - https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/LLmInjection/blob/main/data/detections.json
author: LLMInjection
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
    - llminjection.det-ai-029
    - llminjection.llmi-t011
    - detection.threat-hunting
correlation:
    type: temporal
    rules:
        - llmi_det_ai_029_package_install
        - llmi_det_ai_029_agent_config_write
    group-by:
        - Computer
    timespan: 10m
falsepositives:
    - 'Installing an assistant extension or CLI that legitimately writes its own configuration directory; allowlist known package names once inventoried.'
    - 'Dotfile or workspace bootstrap scripts run right after an install.'
level: low

8b836117-834e-4ebe-b413-dc88ab8aca69.raw:
title: Potential AI Coding Agent Launched With Permission Prompts Disabled
id: 8b836117-834e-4ebe-b413-dc88ab8aca69
status: experimental
description: |
    Detects a coding-agent CLI started with its approval prompts turned off: the Claude Code
    flags documented as skipping permission prompts and the Gemini CLI auto-approve (yolo) mode.
    Such a session executes tool calls without a human decision, which is the precondition
    for autonomous attack orchestration. The same flags are used legitimately in sandboxes and
    containers, so the rule is meaningful only against an inventory of hosts where unattended
    agent runs are sanctioned.
references:
    - https://code.claude.com/docs/en/cli-reference
    - https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/docs/cli/cli-reference.md
    - https://github.com/Ridd1kulusC0d3r/LLmInjection/blob/main/data/detections.json
author: LLMInjection
date: 2026-10-10
tags:
    - llminjection.det-ai-032
    - llminjection.llmi-t015
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    definition: 'Full command line must be collected (Sysmon event 1, EDR process telemetry, auditd EXECVE or equivalent).'
detection:
    selection:
        CommandLine|contains:
            # Claude Code, CLI reference: --dangerously-skip-permissions, "Equivalent to --permission-mode bypassPermissions"
            - '--dangerously-skip-permissions'
            - '--permission-mode bypassPermissions'
            - '--permission-mode=bypassPermissions'
            # Gemini CLI, CLI reference: --approval-mode with the value yolo; --yolo is its deprecated form
            - '--approval-mode yolo'
            - '--approval-mode=yolo'
            - '--yolo'
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - 'Developers running an agent inside a disposable container or VM with approvals off on purpose; allowlist by host group once unattended runs are inventoried.'
    - 'CI jobs that run an agent unattended by design; allowlist by runner identity.'
    - 'Shell history, documentation or scripts that print these flags without launching an agent (for example grep, echo or an editor opening a file).'
level: medium
fp: CI jobs that run an agent unattended by design; allowlist by runner identity.
Shell history, documentation or scripts that print these flags without launching an agent (for example grep, echo or an editor opening a file).

Such a session executes tool calls without a human decision, which is the precondition

314af1d340a3.raw:
| tstats count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime
  from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic
  where All_Traffic.dest_category="ai_provider"
  by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.dest
| rename All_Traffic.* as *
| lookup approved_ai_workloads host as src OUTPUT approved
| where isnull(approved) OR approved!="true"
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
314af1d340a3.desc: A workload with no approved AI dependency contacts an LLM provider or AI gateway.
